name: Sissokosuchus
isnote: English Wikipedia places it in Itasuchidae (Notosuchia); the atlas has no Itasuchidae clade, so it sits in Notosuchia.
sum: Sissokosuchus is an itasuchid notosuchian from the Early Cretaceous 'Continental intercalaire' of Mali, with narrow toothy jaws.
wsnote: No body-length estimate is given in the sources consulted.
holotype: A partial dentary tip, parts of the maxilla and several nearly articulated cranial elements, with some postcranial material (vertebrae, osteoderms, limb bones); catalogue number not given on the page.
biology: Likely lived in or near rivers and may have been semi-aquatic (English Wikipedia).
author: Wilberg et al. 2025

sources.text: Wilberg, E., Hill, R. V., Pascucci, T. R., Roberts, E. M., Bouaré, M. L. and O'Leary, M. A. 2025. A new itasuchid (Crocodyliformes, Notosuchia) from the Early Cretaceous of Mali and the ancient Paleo-Tegama river system of Gondwana. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology e2505473.

dates_note: No PBDB occurrences. Early Cretaceous, roughly Aptian to Albian (English Wikipedia); the ICS Aptian-Albian range is used.
